gaps.title: Mobile top navigation clips labels on One Time surfaces
acceptance: At 390px and 430px nav labels do not clip or disappear without an intentional menu/scroll affordance.
Tap targets remain usable and selected state remains yellow/black.
No horizontal page scroll and no truncated final nav item.

gaps.title: Visible brand display text still uses OneTimeOneTime
acceptance: Visible product label follows the durable One Time / One Time Mishnah naming rule unless config explicitly says otherwise.
Domain/email values such as onetimeonetime.com are not rewritten as display names.
Static tests or readbacks cover public, provider, member, student, and email/review copy surfaces.

gaps.title: Provider workspace metric cards need long-text containment
acceptance: Long emails/status values fit via deliberate wrapping, truncation with tooltip, or label/value layout.
The 390px card grid does not create awkward single-word breaks.
Desktop cards do not clip or hide meaningful provider data.
